goal: J5: a stale plugin cache or too-old runtime produces the named skew diagnostic and its single recovery action without parking a Lane (Spec D2, J5) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S7; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: bun run e2e skew enters drive with a stale plugin cache against newer source, and separately with a runtime older than the required contract; each shows its named skew diagnostic and one recovery action. Negative case: neither run leaves a Lane parked as batch_lane_lost or batch_lane_unreadable. Done looks like: tests/e2e/skew.e2e.ts passes asserting both diagnostics and no parked Lane. Prerequisite: the pinned claude binary from tests/e2e/hosts.json is installed on the QA host (maintainer machine provides claude 2.1.330); an absent binary fails the check rather than skipping.
